title: How Rosie Fordham leads the way in a race 'everybody comes out for'
summary: Rosie Fordham is already Australia's most successful cross-country ski racer in history, and she relished a reminder of the sport's growing popularity as she won the Kangaroo Hoppet. But she has her sights set on getting even better.
